instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain white background and blurred purple wildflowers in the left foreground, three friends sit close together on the floor. On the left, the woman with wavy light-brown hair (R3) sits barefoot in a black crop top, open white shirt, and blue jeans, smiling. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) sits in a white top and denim jacket, laughing warmly. On the right, the curly-haired woman (R1) in a white shirt and blue jeans leans her head against the center woman with a soft smile. They share a tight group hug, with the curly-haired woman and the woman with wavy hair wrapping their arms around the center woman. The scene is illuminated by bright, soft studio lighting.
